### Fewer Than Two Infants Recorded for a Multiple Birth {#sec-problem-details-32}

The patient record says whether the infant is part of a multiple birth and, when it is, how many infants were delivered from that pregnancy, the infant included.
A multiple birth has at least two infants, so the number is 2 or more.
This message appears in the validation report when the record marks a multiple birth but the number of infants at birth is below 2.
The platform asks for the number as soon as the multiple birth is marked and warns at seven or more, but it accepts a 1.

Either the infant is not part of a multiple birth, or the number of infants was entered incorrectly.

Please open the patient record's dashboard (see @sec-solution-1) and edit its profile (see @sec-solution-17): clear the multiple birth mark if the infant is a singleton, or correct the number of infants at birth otherwise.
